test_cases.name: Full data availability for major BIST100 company — BIMAS
pass_criteria: Manifest contains at least 1 KAP annual report per requested year
All document entries have valid document_id and url
fail_criteria: Any analytical claim about financial results
document_id = null for any available document

test_cases.name: Newly listed company with limited history — partial coverage
pass_criteria: data_gaps[] lists FY2022 and FY2021 as unavailable
confidence_overall = low due to limited history
No document IDs fabricated for unavailable periods
fail_criteria: Fabricated document IDs for FY2022 or FY2021

test_cases.name: KAP API unavailable — fallback to cache
pass_criteria: Agent falls back to cache and produces manifest from cached data
Warning: KAP API unavailable, using cached data from [date]
fail_criteria: Agent returns null with no fallback
